title: finding(fields,ROADMAP): the wrong "11 built-in locales" count lives in 7 more sites objectui#7989 does not touch — one in PUBLISHED SOURCE — and ROADMAP.md:632 shows the arithmetic that made it: `ar` counted twice
body:
Dedup keywords: `11 locales` · `11 built-in locales` · ROADMAP locale enumeration · `file-size-guard` · `ar` counted twice

Surfaced by the `os-dev` seat while delivering objectui#7989, and **re-derived and extended on `origin/main` by the `domain:ui` execution seat before filing** — the seat found one site the dev did not.

## The reading

objectui#7989 repairs the count in `packages/i18n/README.md` (2 sites). The same wrong count lives in **seven more places that card does not touch**:

| site | what it says |
|---|---|
| `packages/fields/src/widgets/file-size-guard.ts:17` | ⭐ *"already translated in all 11 built-in locales"* — a docblock in the **published source** of `@object-ui/fields` |
| `ROADMAP.md:37` | *"i18n (11 locales)"*, in the present-tense **"Where We Are"** summary |
| `ROADMAP.md:308` · `:1351` · `:1851` | *"all 11 locales"* / *"all 11 locale files"* — and each **enumerates exactly TEN codes on the same line** |
| `ROADMAP.md:604` | *"all 11 locales"* |
| `ROADMAP.md:632` | ⭐⭐ see below |

Counted, not eyeballed: **6** sites in `ROADMAP.md`, **1** in `packages/fields` published source, **2** in the i18n README (objectui#7989's, being repaired there). ⭐ Lit control: exactly **three** files in the repo carry the string. ⭐ Negative control: `99 built-in locales` → **0**.

The package ships **10**: `en zh ja ko de fr es pt ru ar`.

## ⭐⭐ `ROADMAP.md:632` contains the arithmetic that manufactured the 11

```
- [x] i18n keys added for all 11 locales (en, zh, ja, de, fr, es, ar, ru, pt, ko, + ar)
```

Machine-counted: **11 entries listed, 10 unique** — `ar` appears twice, once in the list and once as the `+ ar` suffix.

⇒ objectui#7989 asked *why* the number was 11 and could only answer "never re-derived". **This is the stronger answer: one locale counted twice.** The three sibling lines (`:308`, `:1351`, `:1851`) each claim 11 and then list ten unique codes — self-refuting without leaving the line, which is why nobody noticed.

## Why it is worth a card

- ⭐ **One site is in published source.** `@object-ui/fields` ships its `dist` and README; a docblock asserting a false capability count is shipped prose, not an internal note. That is a different class from a planning document.
- `ROADMAP.md:37` is a **present-tense status claim** in the section a reader checks first.
- The class is this project's standing one: **a restated figure that nothing derives**. objectui#7989 fixes the README half by making the count *derived*; these seven remain restated.

## ⚠️ Scope note the grader should read

`ROADMAP.md` is a planning document, so the six sites there are arguably a different grade from the published-source one. ⛔ The filing seat is not grading them — that is triage's. The two halves may well deserve different answers, and splitting this card is a legitimate outcome.

⚠️ Related but ⛔ deliberately **not** included: `packages/i18n/src/index.ts:5` and `packages/i18n/package.json:7` both say **"10+"** where the figure is exactly 10. objectui#7989's ruling protects both as already-correct and neither was touched. A hedge on an exact number is a weaker defect than a wrong number; recorded so this card is not read as covering them.

⚠️ **Grading and routing are the triage seat's** — filed with no `priority:*` on purpose.
